entries.reviewNotes: Checked broth-spout bag risk, friend holding bag, below-mark pouring and glove removal before returning bowl across all twelve locales; repaired incomplete Tagalog hint, Nepali broth term and Burmese carrying destination.
Checked older brother not confirmed inside, individual arrival reporting and staff resolution notification in all twelve locales; roles and drill reflection sequence remain consistent.

Read twelve locale sets against applicant injury context; verified husband has not signed, separate trial paper, no tracing before confirmation and applicant explaining ID. Corrected Hindi signature hint and Khmer self-report instruction.

Read all twelve locales against theft-post context: distinguishes reading from eyewitness evidence, unknown photo actions, no speculative naming and no assumed duplicate report; Japanese turn10 and hint differ in wording of recorded time.
Compared all twelve locales with missed-delivery notice context; preserves uncontactable addressee, proxy conditions only, no application or extension assumption and sharing deadline with family.

Compared all twelve locales with deposit context, preserving rent and uncertain return-trip funds, product-specific withdrawal conditions and decision after comparison. Repaired Nepali catch-up metaphor and staff invitation in Hindi and Bengali.

Checked all twelve locales: one-per-person limit remains despite family request, no second register workaround and substitute awaits family reply. Corrected Hindi checkout request so customer pays rather than asks staff to pay.

Checked all twelve locales against park clock misunderstanding: another-park video, no verified music claim, no broken-clock assumption or touching, and reading mechanism notice with child before watching hands.

Read all twelve locales and source context: shifted tools, no opening onsite, box down before route planning, bag behind back, two-hand bottom support and rest at unblocked waiting-area edge remain consistent.

Read all twelve locales and source context: reception volunteer gives no acquaintance priority, verifies name pronunciation rather than face alone, does not amend list from memory and escalates absent names to responsible staff.

Read twelve locale sets against pre-examination context; retains family-call crying separate from eye pain, current absence of pain, eye rubbing only passed on, time to settle and staff confirmation before examination.

Read twelve locale sets against traffic-safety session; retains desire to learn, separate screen and sound concerns, outside waiting with notice, staff recall and later diagram questions without claiming video viewing.

Read all twelve locales: father work-advice letter not yet accepted, private rereading, own thoughts rather than father deciding everything, taking envelope home and returning tomorrow without claiming posting.

Read all twelve locales: reception-only role due to child pickup, no cleanup headcount, Tanaka personal handover agreement and checked receipt before departure. Clarified Vietnamese reception-duty wording.

Read all twelve locales against hospital belongings context; keeps mother buying after requirements check, usual low-scent products, one-hand opening small containers and separate requirement guide versus preference note.

Read all twelve locales against missing ring context; preserves unknown placement rather than witnessed drain fall, no self-disassembly, private two-character inscription, exterior photo versus remembered inner details and management search follow-up.

Read all twelve locales; verifies enlarged inquiry digits against original receipt, eight misread as three, both sheets kept and no delivery-status inquiry today. Replaced Vietnamese interrogation wording with parcel lookup wording.

Read all twelve locales against fictional deposit example; principal remains 100000 yen, interest is separate with no amount determined, conditions retained as questions, and marked copy taken for family reading.

Read all twelve locales against pumpkin purchase context; large knife unknown then small-tools confirmation, choosing two weighed cuts, organizer quantity approval, storage label and insulated bag, no duplicate ingredients.

Read all twelve locales against circle-game context; parent explains turns, child waits rather than blurting, help only if wanted through facilitator, no final scoring and shared celebration of everyone speaking in turn.

Read all twelve locales against joint paper-cut artwork context; retains design/cutting division, one-person form limitation, separate submission and name-publication consent, and reconsidering joint entry rather than sole authorship.

Read all twelve locales against fictional urine-test sequence; retains empty named container, sample not yet possible, staff-confirmed other test first, container in bag, returning to same reception and reporting readiness again.

Read all twelve locales: finished deposit procedure separated from future home financing, appointment guidance not loan acceptance, income and costs prepared, Wednesday preference subject to availability.

Read all twelve locales and checked arithmetic/time sequence: nine start versus ten arrival, today stock of four six-bottle boxes for twenty-four people, two boxes each carried by two people, no tomorrow order and current checkout.

Read all twelve locales: ten/eight-year-old brothers choose drawing/insects separately, age and capacity checked, leaders receive names, parent waits centrally, eleven reunion and all three leave together.

Read all twelve locales: blue umbrella from previous inquiry, reference number plus white handle tape and bent tip, name inside tape, dated collection record, sleeve absent and umbrella secured to bag for home.

changes.before: Ibigay ang bag sa kaibigan at sariling mangkok. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.
changes.after: Sabihing ibibigay ang bag sa kaibigan at ikaw mismo ang hahawak sa mangkok. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.
changes.reason: The fragment about own bowl omits the required decision to hold the bowl yourself.
दासी means female servant rather than the broth dispensed into the bowl.

changes.before: दासीको मात्रा भित्री चिह्नभन्दा तल राख्नुहोस्।
changes.after: सूपको मात्रा भित्री चिह्नभन्दा तल राख्नुहोस्।
changes.reason: Replace the erroneous servant term with broth in the filling instruction.

changes.before: လက်အိတ်ဖယ်ပေးပြီး ညီသွားပါပြီ။ ပန်းကန်ပြန်တင်ပြီးမှ အိတ်ယူကာခုံသယ်ပါမယ်။
changes.after: လက်အိတ်ဖယ်ပေးပြီး ညီသွားပါပြီ။ ပန်းကန်ပြန်တင်ပြီးမှ အိတ်ယူကာ ထိုင်ခုံရှိရာကို သယ်သွားပါမယ်။
changes.reason: The original wording says carry the chair instead of carry the tray to the seat.

changes.before: हाथ घायल होने से पेन की मुश्किल ख़ुद बताइए। जापानी में कहिए।
changes.after: लिखने वाले हाथ में चोट के कारण हस्ताक्षर करने में कठिनाई होने की बात ख़ुद बताइए। जापानी में कहिए।
changes.reason: The source asks the applicant to report signature difficulty, not difficulty with a pen.

changes.before: សូមប្រាប់ខ្លួនឯងថាដៃស្ទាត់របួស ពិបាកចុះហត្ថលេខា។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.after: សូមប្រាប់ដោយខ្លួនឯងថាដៃស្ទាត់របួស ពិបាកចុះហត្ថលេខា។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.reason: The applicant should explain personally to staff, rather than tell themselves.

changes.before: सामग्री पढेपछि निर्णय गर्नेछु। साथीलाई भेट्टाउन आजै सबै रकमको आवेदन गर्दिनँ।
changes.after: सामग्री पढेपछि निर्णय गर्नेछु। साथीको बराबरी गर्न आजै सबै रकमको आवेदन गर्दिनँ।
changes.reason: The catch-up metaphor means matching the friend financially, not finding or meeting them.

changes.before: आज सामग्री घर ले जाइए। विचार करने के बाद आपकी सलाह का इंतज़ार रहेगा। नमस्कार।
changes.after: आज सामग्री घर ले जाइए। विचार करने के बाद आप फिर परामर्श के लिए आएँ, हमें इंतज़ार रहेगा। नमस्कार।
changes.reason: Staff invite the customer to return for consultation rather than wait for advice from the customer.

changes.before: আজ তথ্যপত্র বাড়ি নিয়ে যান। ভেবে দেখার পর আপনার পরামর্শের অপেক্ষায় থাকব। বিদায়।
changes.after: আজ তথ্যপত্র বাড়ি নিয়ে যান। ভেবে দেখার পর আবার পরামর্শ নিতে এলে আপনাকে স্বাগত জানাব। বিদায়।
changes.reason: Preserves staff welcoming the customer back for consultation rather than awaiting customer advice.

changes.before: परिवार का जवाब आया है कि आज नहीं चाहिए। विकल्प मत जोड़िए, केवल मेरी एक वस्तु का भुगतान कर दीजिए।
changes.after: परिवार का जवाब आया है कि आज नहीं चाहिए। विकल्प मत जोड़िए, केवल मेरी एक वस्तु का बिल बना दीजिए।
changes.reason: The customer requests checkout for one item; the original asks staff to make the payment.

changes.before: Tôi có thể trực tiếp nhận trong giờ học, nhưng hết giờ phải đi đón con. Tôi không thể nói là tham gia được cả phần dọn dẹp.
changes.after: Tôi có thể trực quầy tiếp nhận trong giờ học, nhưng hết giờ phải đi đón con. Tôi không thể nói là tham gia được cả phần dọn dẹp.
changes.reason: Clarifies staffing the reception desk rather than the ambiguous phrase directly receive.

changes.before: Nói rõ giới hạn thời gian: có thể trực tiếp nhận nhưng không dọn dẹp được vì phải đón con. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Nói rõ giới hạn thời gian: có thể trực quầy tiếp nhận nhưng không dọn dẹp được vì phải đón con. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: The hint should clearly refer to reception staffing as the available volunteer task.

changes.before: Vâng. Những số nhỏ này khó đọc nên anh/chị viết to số dùng để tra hỏi giúp tôi được không?
changes.after: Vâng. Những số nhỏ này khó đọc nên anh/chị viết to mã tra cứu giúp tôi được không?
changes.reason: Tra hỏi implies interrogation; the parcel context requires an inquiry or tracking reference.

changes.before: Giữ hai tờ cùng nhau, không bỏ phiếu gốc và giữ bên mình khi tra hỏi. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Giữ hai tờ cùng nhau, không bỏ phiếu gốc và giữ bên mình khi tra cứu. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: The learner keeps the receipt for parcel lookup, not for interrogating someone.

scope: AI Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; native/source/device approval separate.
